item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 14/Jun/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Wutip will move across the vicinity of the boundary of Guangdong-Guangxi and weaken gradually today and tomorrow. Under the influence of its associated rainbands, there will be heavy squally showers and thunderstorms over the coast of southern China. It will be windy with rough seas and swells. Wutip will further weaken later tomorrow. However, under the influence of an active southwesterly airstream, there will still be occasional heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over Guangdong early next week. An anticyclone aloft is expected to strengthen gradually in the middle and latter parts of next week. The weather over Guangdong will improve and it will be hot.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional squally showers and thunderstorms. Showers will gradually ease off later. Seas will be rough with swells.
Temp range: 27 - 31 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
